name: zfmv_script_append_action
description: zFMV_Script::AppendAction appends a non-null action to the script list, initializes the first action as head/tail/current, links later actions after the old tail, clears the appended action's next pointer, and returns whether an action was appended.
known_limits: tier S verification is accepted through the zfmv_script_cleanup_reset VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x462f10 validates the null-action early return 0, clearing action->next, initializing m_tail/m_head/m_cur for the first action, linking oldTail->next for later actions, updating m_tail, and returning 1 for appended actions.
The native smoke verifies the null-action no-op, first append head/tail/current initialization with next cleared, and second append tail-link behavior while preserving the current action at the head.
